enroll.title: Secure your account
enroll.subtitle: EduBridge AI requires a second factor at sign-in. Choose how you would like to receive your codes.
enroll.totpOptionBody: Scan a QR code with Google Authenticator, Authy or similar
enroll.emailOptionBody: Receive a 6-digit code by email each time you sign in
enroll.mandatoryNote: A second factor is required for every EduBridge AI account. You can change your method later in Settings.
enroll.totpBody: Open your authenticator app, scan the code below, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
enroll.qrAlt: QR code for setting up your authenticator app
enroll.secretLabel: Cannot scan? Enter this key instead

backupCodes.title: Save your backup codes
backupCodes.body: These are shown once. Each code works a single time if you lose access to your second factor.

guardian.title: Parental link required
guardian.subtitle: Students in Classes 9 and 10 need a parent or guardian to approve their account before the AI Tutor unlocks.
guardian.railBody: For students in Classes 9-10, we require a linked Guardian Space to ensure digital safety, maintain academic integrity, and allow parents to monitor verified curriculum progress effectively.
guardian.explainer: Your parent will receive an email, create their own account, and approve the link from it.
guardian.selfLinkError: This has to be your parent or guardian, not your own address.
guardian.pendingBody: We emailed {email}. This page will update as soon as they approve.
guardian.waiting: Waiting for your parent to approve…
guardian.verifiedBody: Your parent has approved the link. Your account is ready.
guardian.notFoundError: No parent account uses that address yet. Ask them to sign up first, then send the invitation again.

guardianConfirm.title: Approve your child’s account
guardianConfirm.subtitle: Your child has asked you to approve their EduBridge AI account. Confirming links your accounts.
guardianConfirm.step1: Your child will be able to use the AI Tutor and study tools for their board and class.
guardianConfirm.step2: You will see their progress reports and study activity from your own dashboard.
guardianConfirm.step3: You will not see the content of their tutoring conversations — those stay private to your child.
guardianConfirm.signInFirst: You need your own parent account before you can approve this.
guardianConfirm.confirmedBody: You are now linked to {student}’s account.
guardianConfirm.alreadyBody: This account is already linked. There is nothing more to do here.
guardianConfirm.invalidBody: This invitation link is malformed, expired, or has already been used. Ask your child to send a new one.
guardianConfirm.selfLinkError: An account cannot be its own guardian.
guardianConfirm.notAParentError: Only a parent account can approve this link.
guardianConfirm.confirmedBodyNoName: You are now linked to your child’s account.

capabilities.title: Core Capabilities
capabilities.subtitle: Built on a foundation of academic excellence and technical security.
capabilities.curriculumBody: Mapped exactly to PCTB and STBB frameworks for board exam success.
capabilities.bilingualBody: Native-level fluency in English and Urdu, including mathematical notation.
capabilities.groundedBody: Sandboxed AI logic keeps answers grounded in verified curriculum content.
capabilities.adaptiveBody: Dynamic difficulty adjustment based on real-time comprehension levels.

cards.performanceBody: Exam readiness and syllabus coverage across your subjects.
cards.studyNextBody: Prioritised topics based on where your mastery is thinnest.
cards.tutorBody: Ask a question in English, Urdu or Roman-Urdu and work through it step by step.
cards.quizzesBody: Practice sets drawn from your board and class.
cards.myClassesBody: See who can view your progress, and leave any class at any time.
cards.spacesBody: The classes you teach and how each is progressing.
cards.rosterBody: Who is enrolled, and who has not joined yet.
cards.reportsBody: Progress for the subjects in your teaching scope.
cards.sloBody: Which learning outcomes your class has covered, and which are outstanding.
cards.childProgressBody: Verified curriculum progress and study activity over time.
cards.howToHelpBody: Practical suggestions based on where your child is finding things hard.
cards.privacyTitle: What you can and cannot see
cards.privacyBody: You can see progress reports and study activity. You cannot read the content of your child’s tutoring conversations — those stay private to them, by design.
cards.provisioningBody: Accounts, roles and institutional access across the platform.
cards.curriculumAdminBody: Boards, classes and subjects, and how current the mapped syllabus is.
cards.securityBody: Agent software bill of materials, model vetting records and open findings.
cards.quotasBody: Usage limits per account and per institution, and who is close to them.
cards.endpointLogsBody: Which endpoints were called, by how many accounts, and how often. Metadata only.
cards.adminPrivacyBody: You can see audit records, access logs and usage metadata. You cannot read the content of any tutoring conversation — no administrator path to it exists, by design.
